limits: For red wine, Syrah: at least 90%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A northern Rhône appellation, mainly red from Syrah with up to 10% Marsanne or Roussanne. It also makes white from those two grapes. It covers the most land of the northern Rhône, though Crozes-Hermitage has more vines.
